top_signals.title: Pop Mart Drops After Warning 2026 Growth Target Out of Reach
top_signals.summary: Pop Mart International Group Ltd. shares fell the most in nearly five months after the Labubu toymaker said it will likely miss its 2026 sales-growth target, citing a far tougher-than-expected first half.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Korea seeks China’s help as Trump pushes for Kim talks
top_signals.summary: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun called for China to play a constructive role during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart in Seoul on Wednesday.
